profile.headline: Large scale distributed systems | Embedded systems | Application development | Messaging | Networking | Telecom
profile.summary: Seasoned technologist holding multiple U.S. patents with extensive knowledge of large scale distributed systems, embedded systems, application development, messaging, networking, and telecom.  Inventive, versatile, and goal oriented with a wide range of experience from fortune 100 firms to small startups.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Received one U.S. patent on charging components current draw detection technique.
•	Architected company’s next generation DC fast charger inter component communication framework.
•	Introduced role-based access control to secure access to critical components.
•	Prototyped a 2-way AC/DC converter control system.
•	Recognized as the team's go to person on network communication and Linux issues.
•	Streamlined loading of system image to facilitate Boost charger mass production.
•	Supported multiple releases of the Boost DC fast charger.

positions.title: Telco Solution Architect
positions.description:
• Developing enterprise 5G core MANO solution.
• Participation in ONF Stratum Project.
• Developed a POC P4 ready ONLPv2 white box switch showcased during ONF Connect 2019. 
• Led the deployment of 4G end to end POC.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed next generation Sensor Gateway that manages over 20k high voltage sensors.
• Led the development effort to automate the company’s software build and release process.
• Participated in weekly customer deployment troubleshooting sessions.
• Developed multiple releases of the sensor gateway.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
• Designed next generation Wayside Status Relay Service with high availability feature.
• Developed the company’s first Positive Train Control conformant Wayside Status Relay Service utilizing the Interoperable Train Control Messaging framework.
• Co-developed the company’s first Positive Train Control conformant System Management Gateway utilizing the Interoperable Train Control System Management framework.
• Developed Advanced Train Control System conformant back office component.
• Participated in regularly scheduled customer deployment design sessions.
• Developed component, integration, and stress testing procedures.

positions.title: Director of Engineering
positions.description:
• Led the development of Android video collaboration client utilizing H264 SVC.
• Led the development of mobile video collaboration client API.
• Coordinated system deployment at major customer site.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Received thirteen U.S. patents related to network management that are implemented in Cisco’s Configuration Engine product line and resulted in Cisco’s market advantages over rivals.
•	Represented Cisco on Advanced Message Queuing Protocol (AMQP) committee to enhance AMQP performance and add manageability, contributed to version 0.10 of the specification, and gave Cisco a competitive lead on emerging enterprise messaging frameworks.
•	Designed a prototype AMQP mini broker which integrated products from various parts of the company and demonstrated their synergistic effect that won high praises from customers.  
•	Received many Cisco Achievement awards in recognition of innovative solutions, and quality delivery.
•	Created Namespace Mapper which expedited large scale network deployment and reduced customer cost.
•	Architected the first embedded XML parser within Cisco’s IOS, laying the foundation for future network management systems.
•	Designed the Flexible Packet Matcher (FPM) which is one of the key security features in IOS 12.2.
•	Implemented various conferencing features on the Cisco Telepresence Multipoint Switch (CTMS) to improve end user experience and drive sales.    
•	Mentored team members on Object Request Broker (ORB) technology which paved the way for the development of event-based device management systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Created Namespace Mapper which expedited large scale network deployment, reduced customer cost, and improved Cisco’s bottom line.
•Architected the first embedded XML parser within Cisco’s Internet Operating System (IOS), laying the foundation for future network management systems.
•Mentored team members on Object Request Broker (ORB) technology which paved the way for the development of events based device management systems.

patents.title: Component Power Draw Detection for Electric Vehicle Charging Station
Technique for providing dynamic modification of application specific policies in a feedback-based, adaptive data network
